workflow: Built-in image generation, one wordless reference scene per call; sharing-water corrected to place a wide bucket below the tap. Final project assets live in public/course-art/intro-permaculture.

prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a wordless landscape 16:9 educational picture for ImbewuField's South African farmer course, matching a warm hand-drawn Seeds lesson: cream paper, fine brown ink outlines, muted earthy greens, brown, ochre, restrained watercolour shading. One practical, uncluttered scene readable on a phone. At a clean outdoor table next to a modest rural South African kitchen, an African woman in a blue headwrap and green apron sets aside a modest basket of freshly harvested leafy vegetables and a bowl of intact eggs for her family's meal. A second African adult helps sort the harvest; kitchen doorway and a small tended garden beyond establish that this food comes from home. Respectful natural adults, realistic hands and tools, plain everyday clothes. Focus on food reserved for household use. Keep all food on the clean table, no raw-food eating scene, no livestock beside food. No text, labels, numbers, logos, border or title. Not photorealistic or glossy 3D. This is an actual teaching illustration, not a decorative icon.

Use case: illustration-story. Create a wordless landscape 16:9 educational picture for ImbewuField's South African farmer course, matching a warm hand-drawn Seeds lesson: cream paper, fine brown ink outlines, muted earthy greens, brown, ochre and watercolour shading. One practical scene readable on a phone: two African adult smallholders stand safely on a firm path beside their homestead during a light ordinary rain shower. One holds a plain notebook, the other points down at rainwater flowing visibly downhill along the natural shallow ground depression and collecting in a low puddle farther downhill. Show continuous plausible downhill water paths, damp bare patches and some vegetation. No excavated swale or engineered drainage, no flood, no lightning, no deep rushing water; this is watching existing ground before deciding where to dig. Everyday rain jackets and boots, realistic fingers. Modest rural South African homestead background. No arrows, compass, measurements, text, labels, numerals, logos, border or title. Gentle muted colour, not photorealistic or 3D.

Use case: illustration-story. Wordless landscape 16:9 starting frame for a South African smallholder teaching animation. Warm restrained watercolour with visible fine brown pen outlines, earthy greens and ochre on cream paper, like an illustrated farmer handbook, NOT photography. One clear scene: a simple shared water collection tap on a rigid standpipe at a rural homestead. An African adult woman holds the tap handle with ONE hand, and one empty ordinary water container stands securely directly beneath the spout on a small clean concrete apron. Tap currently closed. An African adult neighbour waits with a second container. A third adult to the side holds a plain open monitoring notebook and looks at the other two. Modest rural house and vegetation in distant background, a simple unobtrusive borehole wellhead farther behind away from the collection apron, no visible underground cross section. Ordinary clothing, natural respectful adults, realistic hands. Water collection and mutual agreement are the focus. No gushing water, no overflowing vessels, no puddle around source. Notebook has blank pages for later overlay. No text, numerals, labels, arrows, logo, border or title. The camera and objects need to remain fixed in the later animation.

Use case: illustration-story. Wordless landscape 16:9 teaching picture for South African ImbewuField course. Warm hand-drawn watercolour, fine brown pen outlines, cream paper texture, earthy green and ochre, muted clear shapes, NOT photography or 3D. One practical scene illustrating frequent-use plants near the kitchen: an African woman in everyday clothes stands on a clear short path immediately outside an open kitchen door, leaning gently to pick a few leaves from a small well-kept herb and leafy-green bed beside the path. Kitchen and cooking pot visible through doorway, small harvest bowl in her free hand. A larger vegetable patch appears farther into the modest rural homestead garden. Near bed clearly easy to reach from kitchen, with mulch kept clear of plant stems, comfortable access and no obstacle across doorway. Plants generic leaf forms, no species-identification lesson or labels, normal believable proportions and hands, no daily-picking claim. No words, numbers, arrows, branding, title or frame. Composition focus on the short journey from door to herb bed.

args.prompt: Precise object correction to this wordless farmer illustration. Change only the white receiving container: replace the narrow-neck white jerrycan with a plain wide-mouth white water bucket, upright and securely resting on the same concrete apron. Position its OPEN wide mouth directly below the brass tap spout, so water released from the spout would actually fall inside the bucket. Tap is currently off. No lid on receiving bucket. Keep every person, pose, hand, tap, pipe, notebook, house, colours, drawn watercolour style, framing and all other details unchanged. Add no words or labels.

Use case: illustration-story. Create one landscape 16:9 wordless illustrated START FRAME before a hailstorm, for a South African farming lesson comparing crop diversity. Warm hand-drawn watercolour with fine brown pen outlines, cream paper, restrained earthy colours. Fixed elevated three-quarter camera shows two adjacent rectangular planting plots of clearly EQUAL area and same elevation, same clear unobstructed sky exposure, both inside one simple garden setting. Left plot: repeated upright maize plants of similar height. Right plot: mixed low leafy vegetables and upright crop forms in recognisable orderly groups; no tall trees or roof shielding either plot. A narrow walking path separates the two plots, identical simple soil boundaries. Both plots healthy at this BEFORE stage; distant neutral grey cloud approaching behind both equally. No hail yet, no magically surviving plants, no outcome comparison. Background low rolling rural South African landscape and distant homestead well away from plots. No identifiable new crop labels, no measuring marks, arrows, letters, numbers, words, split-panel border, infographic labels or title. Do not use photography or 3D; keep clear illustrated plants readable on a phone. Later animation will show damage on BOTH plots.

prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Wordless landscape 16:9 South African farming course illustration in warm hand-drawn watercolour with fine brown ink outlines and cream paper texture, muted greens/browns/ochre; NOT photography. An African adult farmer and an older African neighbour stand at a simple waist-high outdoor table just outside a modest homestead, discussing the real garden in front of them. Farmer holds pencil above a plain large cream sheet on the table. Sheet has only a simple freehand boundary outline and small house-outline sketch, NO precise map, rings, compass, letters, numbers or arrows. They have not finished the sketch. Older neighbour points out toward the actual garden and outside boundary, farmer listens. Background shows a kitchen door, a near-door leafy bed, clear path, vegetable beds and farther trees. Large natural people, credible hands and stationary simple tools. Action is observing and discussing before filling in the plan, not proposing a finished design. Leave sheet legible as a simple beginning. No text, logo, frame, title or decorative floating symbols.

Use case: illustration-story. Wordless landscape 16:9 South African smallholder teaching illustration: warm hand-drawn watercolour and fine brown pen on cream paper, earthy greens and ochre; NOT photography. Show a practical planted EDGE beside an existing clear footpath in a modest rural kitchen garden. African adult farmer crouches on the path observing a strip of low leafy groundcover and small flowering generic herbaceous plants along the fence. Garden beds visible to one side, open path continuous and unobstructed to the modest house. Emphasise where two existing areas meet, not maximising edge or narrowing paths. Plant shapes botanical and believable but no named species, no habitat disturbance or planting beside a natural stream. Farmer points to healthy growth already present at the path edge. Normal hands, clear restrained composition readable on a phone. No words, compass, arrows, labels, numbers, border, title, logos or magical growth.

Use case: illustration-story. Wordless landscape 16:9 South African farming educational scene. Warm hand-drawn watercolour, fine brown outlines, cream paper texture, muted earth greens/ochre, NOT photography or 3D. A simple PORTABLE MESH POULTRY ENCLOSURE stands securely over a clearly EMPTY PREVIOUSLY HARVESTED vegetable bed. Four normal adult hens scratch among chopped old crop residue and bare soil inside the enclosure. An African adult farmer stands outside checking the mesh and latched access door. A separate leafy vegetable bed nearby remains fully fenced OFF from the hens; NO hens, fresh manure or feed on any harvestable crop. Fruit trees in the farther background show the arrangement of garden, trees and poultry. Flat accessible ground, shade and a small clean water drinker inside the enclosure. Focus on positioning and protecting growing food; no animation or sequence of immediate planting after manure. No eggs on plants, giant birds, text, labels, time intervals, numbers, arrows, border or title.
